xna-type.name: DxtBitmapContent
xna-type.summary: Provides methods and properties for managing compressed textures (DXT1, DXT3, DXT5). This is the base class for all compressed textures.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of DxtBitmapContent with the specified size.
constructor.syntax: protected DxtBitmapContent ( int blockSize, int width, int height )

parameters.parameter: Size of the block, in bytes.
Width of the bitmap, in pixels.
Height of the bitmap, in pixels.
